## About me

I’m Sarah Kopitz, originally from Brandon, Manitoba. I have a BSc in Environmental Science (Forest Ecology) from the University of Winnipeg and a Master of Geomatics for Environmental Management from the University of British Columbia.

I’m proudly Anishinaabe and German, with a strong interest in Indigenous rights, environmental stewardship, and the relationships between people and the land. I enjoy using GIS, remote sensing, and data to explore environmental questions, solve problems, and communicate information through maps and visuals.

Outside of work, I love spending time with friends and family, getting outdoors, reading, and staying active. I also enjoy being creative, especially through crafting and beading.
